description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget `AddCategoryDialog` used for adding or editing a category. It provides a UI with form fields for entering category name, selecting an icon, and choosing a color. It utilizes Flutter's material design components and references an external `Category` model.

classes.name: AddCategoryDialog
classes.description: A Flutter widget class for displaying a dialog to add or edit a category, with fields for name, icon, and color selection.

classes.name: _AddCategoryDialogState
classes.description: State class managing the internal state of `AddCategoryDialog`, handling form inputs, validation, and submission.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting default or existing category values.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates the form and, if valid, creates a new Category object and closes the dialog, returning the new category.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the dialog, including form fields for name, icon, and color selection, and action buttons.
